questions.q: Match each client metric to what it measures.
pairs: The largest lag in records for any partition, from the consumer's current position
Producer sends that resulted in errors
The fraction of time the producer waits for buffer space
The fraction of time poll is idle rather than waiting for user code
questions.explain: records-lag-max is a consumer fetch metric based on the current offset, not the committed one. record-error-rate and bufferpool-wait-ratio are producer metrics; poll-idle-ratio-avg is a consumer metric. Every rate metric also has a cumulative -total partner.

questions.q: Kafka Streams reports its own metrics in four layers. Put them in order, from the broadest to the narrowest.
items: Processor node, state store and cache
questions.explain: A Streams instance has all the producer and consumer metrics plus its own, in four layers: client, thread, task, and processor node / state store / cache. metrics.recording.level (default info) chooses how many are recorded.
